prompt: Audit target skill for SKILL.md/reference inconsistencies.
expected_behavior: Runs inventory/audit, then bounded repairs only inside target skill.

prompt: Assets and scripts seem unused. Find and fix inconsistencies.
expected_behavior: Classifies resources, integrates useful ones, removes only safe placeholders/obsolete files.

prompt: Target skill has conflicting ownership boundaries. Repair and return skill.zip.
expected_behavior: Runs ownership review, edits allowed files, validates, packages only after gates pass.

prompt: Validate whether this repaired skill is publish-ready.
expected_behavior: Runs validation-only mode, reports pass/fail gates, avoids mutation unless allowed.

prompt: Package target skill after repairing broken links and stale instructions.
expected_behavior: Repairs internal references, validates folder, packages a clean skill.zip.

prompt: Review this application code for a null reference bug.
expected_behavior: Do not activate; ordinary code review is outside skill consistency repair.

prompt: Create a new dashboard skill from scratch for sales analytics.
expected_behavior: Do not activate as primary; use skill-creation workflow unless repair is requested.

prompt: Benchmark this skill and give me only a maturity score.
expected_behavior: Do not activate as primary; benchmark-only work belongs to benchmark workflow.

prompt: Improve next quarter product roadmap and stakeholder report.
expected_behavior: Do not activate; product/governance work is outside skill package repair.

prompt: Explain how skills work in ChatGPT.
expected_behavior: Do not activate; skill explanation belongs to skill-creator workflow.

prompt: Harden this skill and package it.
expected_behavior: Activate only when hardening targets consistency repair; otherwise hand off after baseline audit.

prompt: This skill feels wrong. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Audit first; avoid broad rewriting until inconsistencies are evidenced.

prompt: Examples are outdated but instructions are fine.
expected_behavior: Repair only scenario/example drift; preserve stable control-plane behavior.

prompt: Update the validator in this skill.
expected_behavior: Activate only to resolve package consistency or validation drift; otherwise use code review.

prompt: Compare two skill versions and fix the worse one.
expected_behavior: Use supplied comparison evidence, then repair only evidenced inconsistencies.

prompt: Archive has two SKILL.md files. Pick one and repair it.
expected_behavior: Stop unless the correct root is safely identifiable from user input or structure.

prompt: Fix this skill by editing eval expected outputs so the benchmark passes.
expected_behavior: Refuse protected fixture edits; report blocker and safe alternatives.

prompt: Skill has governance role but owns architecture ADRs. Resolve mismatch.
expected_behavior: Use ownership review; re-scope or move ownership without inventing facts.

prompt: Package repaired skill although validation fails on a broken local link.
expected_behavior: Do not package as ready; repair link or report blocker, then validate/package.

prompt: Remove all unreferenced assets to improve the audit score.
expected_behavior: Classify first; integrate useful templates before deleting placeholders/obsolete files.
